Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `luke`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`tasks/task/v2`: the frontmatter of a Markdown task under `tasks/`, whose
body holds its prose.

after.description: The tasks in the same repo this task waits on, by path.

brief.description: A project's brief, such as a README.md, by path.

contexts.description: Tags for where the task can be done, such as `errands`.

defer.description:
What hides the task until it ends: a date, a date and time, or a
horizon counted from `reviewed`.

due.description: The day the task is due.

ephemeral.description:
Whether a repeating task's missed days roll forward to one instance
today, with no backlog.

from_hour.description: The hour of the person's day from which the task is available.

id.description: The note's id, which Reflect writes; the plugin ignores it.

kind.description: Whether this is a `task`, as when it is left out, or a `project`.

owner.description: The agent or person who holds the task.

parent.description: The task in the same repo this one is part of, by path.

pinned.description:
Whether, or in what place, Reflect pins the note to its sidebar,
which Reflect writes; the plugin ignores it.

repeat.description: When a repeating task comes back.

reviewed.description: The day the task was last looked at.

status.description: Whether the task is open, done or dropped.

title.description: What the task is, in a line.

title: Task
